items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee recounts a story where a neighbor asks 'Sister Mac' if the family went to church, but there is no indication that Jay McShann personally knew or interacted with this 'Sister Mac'.

ctx.x: They spent a lot of hours in church, did they?

Well, you know, they go to Sunday school about 9:30 and then church at 11 and they'd get home at about 12:30 or 1:00. So finally, one old sister come by the house. She says, "Sister Mac, did you all go to church today?" She says, "Yeah, we all went to church. Everybody except the boy. The boy was sick, you know. He was feeling bad. He ate something, so he stayed here." "What was that I heard at your house?" She says, "I don't know, what?" She said, "Well, he might have been sick, but somebody was sure playing…
